This appeal coming on for orders this day, the court passed
the following:
 Order

This miscellaneous appeal filed has been filed by the appellant - Insurance Company under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, being aggrieved by award dated 27.09.2007 passed in MACC No.126 of 2005 by Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Indore (MP).

(2) Learned counsel for appellant/Insurance Company submits that in the instant case, accident occurred on 23.03.2005 and FIR has been lodged after 18 days on 09.04.2005 and no explanation has been furnished by the respondents/claimants.

Learned counsel for the appellant after referring Oreintal Insurance Co.Ltd. vs Mahesh Ray & 2 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170453056/
1 to above as well as testimony of PW/1 and PW/2 submits that offending vehicle has been falsely involved in the accident and as after thought.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also urged that at the time of accident, driver of offending vehicle was not having any valid or effective licence.
Further, it is also urged that the amount of compensation determined by the Tribunal is on higher side.
On above grounds, it is submitted that appeal be allowed and impugned award passed by Tribunal be set-aside.
(3) Learned counsel for the respondent/claimant has pleaded no instructions.
(4) I have heard learned counsel for the appellant and perused the records of the case.
(5) A perusal of the record of case file reveals that respondents/claimants has filed the documents Ex.P/1 to Ex.P/28 and above documents relates to treatment etc of claimant.
It is apparent from the records of the case that claimant/respondent has not produced any documents filed along with charge-sheet relating to investigation of present accident.

It is also apparent from the record that claimant has not filed FIR, charge-sheet, spot-map and seizure of offending vehicle etc to prove the factum of accident as well as the involvement of offending vehicle in the instant case.
It is also apparent from the record that no explanation has been furnished for non-filing of above material documents.
(6) Hence, on above ground adverse inference may be drawn against the respondent/claimant, if he had filed above documents, they may have not been corroborated or supported claimant's case.

(7) Hence, in view of above, in this Court's considered opinion, only on the basis of oral testimony, it cannot be said that offending vehicle was involved in the instant case and it was being driven rashly and negligently.

Accordingly, appeal is allowed and impugned award passed by the Tribunal is set-aside and the respondent/claimant - Mahesh Ray is directed to refund the compensation amount deposited by the appellant-Insurance Company along with interest @ 6% per annum within three months from today.
(8) With the aforesaid direction, the appeal stands disposed of.
(9) Certified copy, as per Rules.
(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL)

JUDGE Arun/-
